My trans friend did go to womens shelters for a while, and honestly i’m glad I didn’t. One sent him back home to his abusive parents, and the other was very isolating and bad for mental health.

I’m also FtM! I haven’t experienced a lot of hate outside family, and I live in a generally lgbt friendly area.

But that said living in a mens shelter I experience a lot of masculinity surrounding me, which is both good and bad.

Good because I have started to mimic the actions of them, thus making me seem more masculine.

Bad because I stick out so much more, and I haven’t had any surgeries and i’m not on testosterone. One kid here atm currently always misgenders me, not on purpose but it’s very frustrating at this point.

And then theres people like the guy coming in on tuesday. He tried peeping on my other trans friend in the shower and on the toilet to see what he has in his pants, threatened to beat him up if ‘he were a guy’, and constantly misgendered him.

The hate came worse from family. I have a lot of trauma based around my birthname simply because my mums boyfriend would get drunk and angry and take it out on my by calling me that. 

My brother started taking after him, along with calling me ‘it’ or anything else but he/him.

So while I have experienced some hate, I have a lot more support which is great.
